premises.text: HTML5 and browser stacks have inherent flaws that prevent native-class performant 3D apps
premises.evidence_span: there are inherent flaws that exist in the browser that make that impossible

premises.text: Treating a game engine as an app engine and talking directly to the GPU delivers high-performance 3D/2D across phones, PCs, and consoles in JavaScript
premises.evidence_span: what if a game engine is an app engine

premises.text: Success requires bridging 2D and 3D so the switch is merely a settings option for developers
premises.evidence_span: we won't succeed unless we build a bridge from the 2D world to the 3D world

premises.text: Famo.us gives JavaScript engineers a new tool that can outperform HTML5 and native for web apps
premises.evidence_span: this gives JavaScript engineers a new tool in their tool belt that they didn't have before

value.text: Designers and engineers can build performant 3D/2D experiences previously impossible in the browser
value.evidence_span: there is a whole new world out there that you didn't know that existed

causal_links.evidence_span: inherent flaws that exist in the browser
if you can solve 3D, you can solve 2D

notes: Console/device list and GPU bypass folded into game-engine mechanism (§4.1.7). Template gallery aspiration treated as illustration of tool value, not separate premises. Democratize-3D WordPress analogy folded into developer-tool premise. Beta signup excluded as CTA. Two domains.
